@@U02477@@
pointy ears peeping out.
Our nose is snub,
our face is wide,
but women like us all the same.

@@U02479@@
A satyr, I hop behind him on goat’s feet
and scrawny legs that suit me just fine.
For chamoislike, to amuse myself,
I climb high peaks to survey the world.

@@U02481@@
Here we little gnomes come tripping,
not in pairs, but one by one,
crissing and crossing as we foot it.

@@U02483@@
(Surrounding great PAN.)

@@U02484@@
Great Pan is here!
Great Pan is come!
Great Pan who is All!
Surround him, nymphs, with happy dance,
float about him, circle him round!
He may be earnest, but he’s kindly, too,
and he wishes us all to be merry.
He would be watchful,
would be ever attentive,
beneath the blue of heaven's arch,
except that brooklets ripple past,
and gentle, soft breezes caress him to drowse.
And when at noon he sleeps,
no leaf stirs,
and in the silent, motionless air
the healthy scent of Nature hovers,
and no nymph dare stay awake,
but falls asleep just where she stands.
Suddenly then his voice cries out
like lightning’s crash, like the roaring sea,
and panic descends on even the mightiest,
armies scatter and heroes tremble.
translation:
@@U02477@@
尖尖的耳朵向外张望。
我们的鼻子塌了
我们的脸很宽，
但女人都喜欢我们。

@@U02479@@
色狼，我踩着山羊脚跳到他身后
还有骨瘦如柴的腿，很适合我。
为了像羚羊一样，为了自娱自乐，
我攀登高峰来观察世界。

@@U02481@@
我们小侏儒在这里绊倒，
不是成双成对，而是一一对应
当我们踏上它时，它会纵横交错。

@@U02483@@
（周围有很棒的 PAN。）

@@U02484@@
大锅来了！
大潘来了！
伟大的潘就是一切！
仙女们，用快乐的舞蹈围绕着他，
漂浮在他周围，绕着他转！
他可能很认真，但他也很友善，
他祝愿我们大家都快乐。
他会保持警惕，
会一直用心，
在蓝色的天堂拱门下，
除了溪流荡漾过去，
轻柔的微风抚摸着他，让他入睡。
中午他睡觉的时候，
没有树叶翻动，
在寂静、静止的空气中
弥漫着大自然健康的香气，
没有仙女敢保持清醒，
但就在她站着的地方睡着了。
突然他的声音喊了起来
如同闪电的撞击，如同咆哮的大海，
即使是最强大的人也会感到恐慌，
众军四散，英雄颤抖。
